## Join the lab

We welcome people from all backgrounds who are curious about bees, behaviour and the natural world. Experience with fieldwork, coding or museum collections is helpful but not required for every role.

### Open positions

<!-- List advertised PhD projects and postdocs here, with deadlines and links. -->
There are no advertised positions at the moment.

### PhD students

We support applications through doctoral training programmes and fellowships. If you'd like to discuss a project, email a short note about your interests and a CV.

### Undergraduate and MSc students

QMUL students can carry out dissertation and research projects in the lab, from field-based work on ground-nesting bees to computational work on specimen images.

### Postdoctoral researchers

We're happy to support fellowship applications that fit the lab's research. Please get in touch well ahead of the deadline.
